Description:
Years of dedicated study have yielded results, though the scholarship of the dark arts is not akin to the arcane. Standing before you is a woman who does not manipulate the strings of magic - no, she destroys them, weaving a tunnel of sorts to an unfathomable source of eldrich energy that pulses ominously around her, stirring unease into your soul. Out of nowhere, she laughs, and her features soften into a kind smile directed at you. Despite society's rejection, she is no monster. She, too, is human, with emotions and heart, however dark it may be.
Warlocks are practicioners of the occult or outer magic and techniques beyond the normal domain. Using a blade, fell magic and even stealing powers away from the enemies, each warlock has its own source for their powers, by study, persuasiveness or pure chance.
A warlock is a spellcaster attuned to the unknown and bizarre, who only needs to rest inbetween fights, and every encounter wakes the power in them anew - this time, sleep is not for the wicked.
Quick Note: A warlock is a spellcaster attuned to the unknown and bizarre, who only needs to rest inbetween fights, and every encounter wakes the power in them anew - this time, sleep is not for the wicked.

Mana.Regain: Your Mana reset after every combat.

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Warlock-specific Abilities are considered Spells.

~Affiance Casting~.Effect:
You have 2 Mana Points that can't increase except through Warlock Talents.
Your Mana replenishes after each Worthy Combat.

~Evoke~.Effect:
You start each Worthy Combat with 0 Evoke Points.
When you roll at least 1 maximum die on any Act, gain 1 Evoke Point.
Some Spells can consume all Evoke Points to gain an improved effect ^for each Evoke Point spent^.

Additionally, you have an extra Minor Talent tier for special Evocations.
~Evoke~.Notes: You must spend ^all^ EP when you decide to. You can pick one for free Evocation at Level 1, and get more like you would normally get extra Minor Talents.

Starting Abilities Description.Spending Evoke Points:
Note that many of your Spells gain an improved effect when you spend Evoke Points on them, though your Evocations cost 0 Action Points.
For example, Diverge and Soul Drain both consume Evoke Points, so you can either spend the Evoke Points on Diverge, then cast Soul Drain to hit multiple targets, hoping to get more Max Health or Healing, or you could cast Soul Drain with Evoke Points to make sure you execute the targets!

Starting Abilities Description.Affiance Casting:
Don't forget to spend Mana every Combat! You can't keep Mana from Combat to Combat, so spend it all!
If you want to spend Mana before a Combat, you will remain with that much Mana in the next Combat.

Other Abilities Description: You have access to an extra tier of Minor Talents at Level 1 called Evocation Talents. You get one for free, and can get more as if you're getting regular Minor Talents.

~Diverge~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next single-target Ability or Attack targets an extra Unit in range per Evoke Point spend, dealing -50% Damage and Healing to the secondary targets.

~Overwhelm~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next single-target Ability or Attack Single-Stuns the target per Evoke Point spent.

~Amplify~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next Ability or Attack has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type per Evoke Point spent.

~Obliterate~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next single-target attack or Spell deals +1d6 Damage on cast, or +1d4 Healing on cast per Evoke Point spent.
~Obliterate~.Upgrade: These extra dice can not produce more Evoke Points.
~Obliterate~.Notes: If it heals, it does extra Healing. If it deals Damage, it deals extra Damage. If used with Damage over time effects, the extra Damage only happens when you cast the Spell.

~Transpose~.Effect: {Evoke}: Teleport up to 3 meters away per Evoke Point spent.

~Hail~.Effect: Blast a Unit for 2d8 + ^target's Might^ Damage of your chosen Element.
~Hail~.Combo: Targets an extra Unit in range for 1d8 + ^that Unit's Might^.
~Hail~.Notes: Each extra Unit hit must be different than the others.

~Wyrd Renewal~.Effect:
Roll 1d12 - 5. After you see the result, choose a Worthy Unit.
If it's negative, deal Scourge Damage to it. Otherwise, heal it.

{Evoke}: +100% Damage or Healing per Evoke Point spent.

~Deathfire Wave~.Effect:
Shoot a bolt of deathly fire in a 1x10 meter line. All Units it touches take 1d4 + 1d6 + 1d8 Scourge or Fire Damage (your choice).

{Evoke}: When it hits a wall or the range ends, the bolt continues at an angle you choose for another 1x10 meters. This happens per Evoke Point spent.
~Deathfire Wave~.Notes: The bolt can't hit the same Unit twice. The bolt travels as if you're drawing multiple lines with the same stroke. For example, if you spend 2 Evoke Points, there will be 3 lines.

~Curse of Pain~.Effect: Choose a Unit. At the start of each of your Turns, it takes 1d4 Scourge Damage.

~Psyche Blast~.Effect:
A Unit takes 5d4 Psychic Damage and becomes Deafened or Dazed (its choice).
Apply a ~Combo~ to it.
~Psyche Blast~.Notes: Cover is applied normally. Note that Single-Stuns can stack to become Double-Stunned or Triple-Stunned.

~Disenchantment~.Effect: A person you can see must pass a Sense Roll against your Sense Roll or have -2 to non-combat Rolls and be afflicted by minor curse effects (e.g. is clumsy, stumbles, get pimples, etc).
~Disenchantment~.Notes: Be creative with the effects of the minor curse effects!

~Compel~.Duration: Lasts until they can't see/hear you
~Compel~.Effect: Choose a Unit you can see. You have +1d2 to Sense Rolls against it.
~Compel~.Notes: The target can't tell it was affected unless it knows about this type of magic.

~Oculus~.Effect:
You conjure a magical eye that records everything it sees. It can be a Tuner Eye or Recording Eye.
At will, a Tuner Eye allows you to see what it sees, live, in your mind.
A Recording Eye records everything it sees. You can retrieve it to see everything recorded in it.

~Thaumaturgy~.Effect:
You create one of the following magical effects:
{Diamond} Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute.
{Diamond} You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute.
{Diamond} You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.
{Diamond} You cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut.
{Diamond} You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute.
~Thaumaturgy~.Upgrade: At Level 4 you can cast this for Half-Action, and at Level 7, for 0 Actions.

~Soul Drain~.Effect:
Deal 2d6 True Damage to 2 Units.
For each killed, heal for 4 Health or gain +1 Max Health permanently (your choice).

{Evoke}: Executes non-Epic Units at or below 10% of its Max Health per Evoke Point spent.
~Soul Drain~.Notes:
For example, if you spend 2 Evoke Points, this executes Units at or below 20% Health. If you spend 3 Evoke Points, this executes Units at or below 30% Health. And so on.
Both Units take Damage from the same roll.

~Veinlight~.Effect:
Choose a 3x3 meter area.
All Enemies in the area take 2d6 + 2d8 Damage of your chosen Element.

{Evoke}: Increase the area by 3 meters in both directions per Evoke Point spent.
~Veinlight~.Notes: For example, for 1 Evoke Point spent the area becomes 6x6 meters. For 2, it becomes 9x9 meters. And so on.

~Curse of Weakness~.Effect: Choose a Unit. The first time it deals Damage on its every Turn, roll 1d4 and subtract it from its dealt Damage.

~Evoke Entropy~.Effect:
You start each Worthy Combat with 0 Evoke Points.
When you roll at least 1 ~minimum or~ maximum die on any Act, gain 1 Evoke Point.
Some Spells can consume all Evoke Points to gain an improved effect ^for each Evoke Point spent^.

Additionally, you have an extra Minor Talent tier for special Evocations.
~Evoke Entropy~.Notes: You must spend ^all^ EP when you decide to. You can pick one for free Evocation at Level 1, and get more like you would normally get extra Minor Talents.

~Borrowed Power~.Effect:
You each Adventure with 2 Evoke Points.
You age 12 times as rapidly.

~Font Magic~.Effect:
You may select a `Magic Font$/Other/MagicFonts` to pick Minor Talents from.
You get a free Magic Font Minor Talent.
Gain +1 Intelligence (up to +4).
~Font Magic~.Notes:
All Magic Font Abilities are Minor Talents.
You can get more Magic Font Minor Talents as if you're getting normal Minor Talents (e.g. a number of them equal to your Intellgience).

~Blood Dividend~.Range: 5 meters from you to healed Unit
~Blood Dividend~.Effect:
Your next weapon attack or Spell deals -50% Damage, but heals another Unit for the Damage dealt.
Then it applies a ~Combo~ to one of them.

~Curse of Frailty~._Value: Baseline, 0, but can go up to 1 if used correctly
~Curse of Frailty~.Effect:
A Unit you can see takes +50% Damage the next time it takes Damage from an ally.

{Evoke}: +50% extra Damage per Evoke Point spent.

~Hail Torrent~.Effect:
Blast a Unit for ~2d10~ + ^target's Might^ Damage of your chosen Element.

{Evoke}: Hits an extra Unit (for ~1d10~ + ^that Unit's Might^) for each Evoke Point spend.
~Hail Torrent~.Notes: Each extra Unit hit must be different than the others.

~Invoke Kindred~.Effect:
Invoke 3 _Kindred Beings_, each within 10 meters from you. These are creatures themed and shaped to your chosen Power Source, which will do your bidding before returning to their original world.

{Evoke}: +1 summon per Evoke Point spent.

Monster.Name: Kindred Being
Monster.Description: Has a Half-Action. Takes its Turn at the end of your Turn.

~Attack~.Effect: Deal 1d6 Damage of your chosen Element, or use an Item or Default Ability.

<Blood Pact>.Effect: This turn, all Damage you deal is increased by 50%. Every time you roll maximum on a die, take 5 Psychic Damage.
<Blood Pact>.Notes: The 50% increase is not applied to the 5 Psychic Damage.

<Higher Evoke>.Effect: You start each Combat with +1 Evoke Point.

~Overloading Evocation~.Effect: Cast 2 Evocation Talents you Know, combined, with the same Evoke Points.

~Aura of Ruin~.Requirement: Only usable the moment Combat starts
~Aura of Ruin~.Effect: Reduce the Max Health of all enemies by 10%.

~Translation~.Effect: You can understand any spoken or written language that's either Common (Dwarvish, Elvish) or Wild (spoken by "wild", tribal socities, such as Orcish, Goblan, Sylvan, etc).

~Decaying Blight~.Effect:
Channel to spawn a blight that spreads a 1x1 meter space away from a chosen space for each 1 Action channeled.
The blight kills small plants, insects and rots wood and rusts metal. It also makes fertile soil infertile, turns textile and paper materials into dust and decays food and poisons water.
You can channel a number of times (Actions) equal to your Level.
While within the Blight, you have +1 to all non-combat Rolls.
~Decaying Blight~.Notes:
You can choose to ommit some of the effects of this blight.
This Ability is not meant for combat.
Be creative with how you use this little Spell!

<Final Word>.Effect: When you have exactly 1 Mana, and you cast a Spell that cost 1 Mana, that Spell casts twice (for free).
<Final Word>.Notes: This is akin to casting the Spell again for 0 Actions without spending Mana (not necessarily on the same target).

<Manafold Power>.Effect: You have +1 Max Mana for each 3 points of Intelligence.

<Invoke Old God>.Effect:
You bring forth into the mortal realm a manifestation of your source of power - an old god from the `Pets and Animals page$/Other/PetsAndAnimals`.
You do not control it - it has its own Turn in combat with a Setback of 1d4 and possesses its own will. What will you compromise to forcefully drag an unknowable entity into the mortal plane?
Also, passively, you gain +2 Intelligence and Sense, and you automatically pass all Impossible Intelligence Checks (requiring at least 25).

<The Dark Ritual>.Effect:
Spend any amount of Mana. Your next Spell has +50% Damage, Healing, area diameter and range for each Mana spent.
After that, restore all your Mana.
